items.title: Lemonade Reports Q3 Net Loss of $43.7M Amid 34% Growth in In Force Premium
items.summary: Insurtech Lemonade posted a third-quarter net loss of $43.7 million alongside higher revenue and increased operating expenses driven by marketing investments.

items.title: Pulse Insurance details specialist underwriting approach for complex medical and high-risk cover
items.summary: Lloyd’s Coverholder Pulse Insurance has outlined its specialist underwriting framework for personal accident, high-risk travel, and complex life insurance.

items.title: Progress Residential and Pretium Partners Agree to $48.5M Settlement Over Rental Practices
items.summary: Indiana Attorney General Todd Rokita and federal regulators have secured a settlement with rental home operators Progress Residential and Pretium Partners over deceptive pricing and fee allegations.

items.title: Insurance Age Site Error
items.summary: Technical issues prevented access to the requested Broker Expo coverage from Insurance Age.

items.title: Insly launches workflow tool Nora to address operational friction in specialist MGAs
items.summary: Policy administration and AI provider Insly has introduced Nora to automate submission handling and broker chasing for specialist Managing General Agents.

items.title: European ETFs record €40.8bn in October inflows
items.summary: Morningstar data reported by Investment Week shows exchange-traded funds and commodities in Europe gathered €40.8bn during October.
